description: This PHP class 'ImpactItemFootprint' models the association between impact items and footprints within the Goteo project, providing methods to retrieve, save, validate, and delete impact-footprint relationships.

classes.name: ImpactItemFootprint
classes.description: A model class representing the link between impact items and footprints, with methods to manage this association.

methods.name: getImpactItem
methods.description: Returns the ImpactItem associated with this footprint impact.

methods.name: setImpactItem
methods.description: Sets the ImpactItem for this footprint impact.

methods.name: getFootprint
methods.description: Returns the Footprint associated with this impact item.

methods.name: setFootprint
methods.description: Sets the Footprint for this impact item.

methods.name: getListByFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves all ImpactItemFootprint records associated with a given Footprint.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactItemFootprint record to the database, inserting or updating as necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the ImpactItem and Footprint are set before saving.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes the ImpactItemFootprint record(s) from the database based on specified conditions.
